subject: What happens during a home consultation
hook: Thirty seconds inside a SUPERIO design visit, from first question to finish samples.
ig:
Thirty seconds inside a SUPERIO design visit, from first question to finish samples.

The visit is where the real design work starts, and most of it is listening. We want to know who uses the room, what has to live in it, and what drives you mad about it now.

Then we look at what the room will allow. Sockets, radiators and a sloping ceiling all change what fits, so it pays to spot them early.

Finish samples come out next, held where the furniture will actually go. Oak-effect and charcoal can look very different in your light compared with a photo online.

After the visit, the room is measured properly and you receive an itemised quote. If you go ahead, it is built in our own workshop in Hanley and fitted by our own team.

Thinking about fitted furniture this autumn? Comment VISIT and we will send you the link to book.
fb:
We get asked a lot what a design visit actually looks like, so here it is in half a minute.

Most of the time we are listening: what the room is for, what needs a home, and what is not working. Then we look at the practical bits, like sockets and radiators, and bring out finish samples so you can see them in your own light rather than on a screen.

After that comes a proper measure and an itemised quote. If you go ahead, everything is made in our Hanley workshop and fitted by our own team.

If you are planning a project for the new year, now is a good time to have that first conversation:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=autumn-interiors-and-practical-comfort&utm_content=day-051
